profile.headline: Software Engineer at OnPoint Community Credit Union
profile.summary:
I am an IT Professional experienced in working in a fast-paced environment demanding strong organizational, technical, and interpersonal skills. Trustworthy, ethical, committed to superior customer service. Confident and poised in interactions with individuals at all levels. Detail oriented and resourceful in completing projects; able to multi-task effectively.

My objective is to gather and develop rewarding experiences using my Networking and Client related services in a leading company which will challenge and allow me to broaden my Network and Tech support skills and expertise to the best of my ability within a team oriented workplace.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.insights: ASP.NET Core, Agile Methodologies and +5 skills

positions.title: Assistant Infrastructure Manager
positions.description: Helped manage our Infrastructure team with planning, design and maintenance of all technology services.
positions.insights: Virtual Private Network (VPN), Storage and +4 skills

positions.title: Sr Network Engineer
positions.description: Worked heavily on the L3 Network to OSPF to be able to accommodate different routing products in the network.  Setup and fully tested DR.
positions.insights: Cisco Meraki, VMware vCenter and +7 skills

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Switching & Routing (Cisco)
Network Design
Firewall Administration (Fortigate, Cisco ASA)
Load Balancer Administration
DMZ administration
WLAN Design/Implementation/Maintenance (Aruba)

positions.title: Systems Administrator for Content Network Services
positions.description:
•	DMZ network maintenance.  
•	Install new physical services as needed depending on the network capabilities.
•	Upgrade IOS version on Cisco 3750s, Force10 S25, Force10 S4810, Cisco 6509, Force10 C150s and Force10 C300
•	Configure and Install switches as needed according to network design requests.
•	Coordinate redundancy tests
•	DNS services
•	Add/Delete/Change domains/records  to DNS.
•	Monitor DNS services thru spectrum alarm system and F5 load balancers to be able to detect possible DDOS attacks.
•	Firewall Administration
•	Configure new rules to open/deny access from local network to the outside world.
•	Upgrade code as necessary
•	Deploy and configure new firewalls as needed.
•	WPAD & Proxy.  
•	Maintain wpad entries and configurations in various servers.  
•	Maintain all proxy servers (add routes, software updates)

positions.title: Data Networks Services and Support Level 1
positions.description:
•	Coordinate Level 1 support to local campus and remote offices
•	In charge of remedy ticketing system.  Resolve all level 1 and level 2 incidents reported to the group
•	Coordinate data closet cableling installation.  Worked with contractor and eng to install all office cat 6 cables. 
switches.
•	Maintenance of Cisco switches.
•	Installed cisco equipment based on growth demand.
•	Maintanance of the WLAN controllers and APs
•	Monitored all APs thru airwave management platform and Cisco WCS
•	Converted AP to light weight
•	Managed ACS server for authentication
•	Network Monitoring
•	Monitored Network thru Spectrum.
•	Add discovered devices accordingly
•	Monitor the riverbeds for WAN optimization
•	APC infrastructure monitoring for all UPS around campus and affiliate offices

positions.title: Operations Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Coordinate outgoing/incoming show feeds for ESPN International Networks.
•	Shipping and Receiving of decoders (D9850) to all affiliates over the world.
•	Plan possible issues with transmission such as the use of frame stores’ usage for all time sensitive live events
•	Update the International sport code tiers and network specific authorizations with Encryption.
•	Client Services” helpline operator. Trouble-shoot feeds, live events, encryption and satellite inspections.
